observation: Recall changed its deterministic default Learning/output paths in commits 4a2cd7c6e193bea740fb549dfca96ac08a752313 and 4e19e1ab51100d566eadde6d4b793996041154c7 while the exported agent-recall-consumer skill still taught the historical infra/doc/agent-learning and .agent-recall-output choreography until e1717c3a0940c839fd5936372d6380a78cc9572d.

evidence.summary: voku/agent-recall-compiler@4a2cd7c6e193bea740fb549dfca96ac08a752313 changed discovery to prefer/default <cwd>/.agent-loop/learning; @4e19e1ab51100d566eadde6d4b793996041154c7 changed standalone CLI defaults to .agent-loop/learning and .agent-loop/recall/<task-id>.
voku/agent-recall-compiler@e1717c3a0940c839fd5936372d6380a78cc9572d later removed the stale roots from agent-recall-consumer and added testConsumerSkillMatchesCurrentCliDefaultsAndCommands().
Current agent-recall-consumer on main documents the .agent-loop defaults and no longer carries the historical infra/doc/agent-learning or .agent-recall-output command examples.

hypothesis: Package provenance and byte identity cannot prevent semantic drift when an exported consumer skill duplicates deterministic public owner behavior and that behavior changes independently.
validated_conclusion: A package-owned consumer skill that states deterministic public owner behavior can become operationally stale even with correct provenance. Keep such claims aligned in the owner change or protect them with a focused owner-side parity regression; do not infer semantic freshness from export provenance alone.

validation_case.given: A package-owned consumer skill states a deterministic public owner command, default, path, or state contract.
validation_case.when: The owning package changes that deterministic public behavior.
validation_case.then: The skill changes coherently in the owner change or a focused owner-side parity regression proves its existing claim remains current.
